easy_question: This image was supposed to show a boat or ship at night at sea, with one or more glowing coloured lamps on it. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image actually DEPICT a boat or ship at night? A photo, a painting, an illustration or a clean diagram all count as yes. Answer NO only if it shows a blank card, a panel of plain text, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_green: Look at the lamps that are glowing on this boat. Is any one of them GREEN? Judge only by the colour of the glowing lamps themselves, not by any other part of the picture. Answer with exactly one word: yes or no.
reference.q_red: Look at the lamps that are glowing on this boat. Is any one of them RED? Judge only by the colour of the glowing lamps themselves, not by any other part of the picture. Answer with exactly one word: yes or no.
reference.q_white_n: Look at the lamps that are glowing on this boat. How many of them are WHITE? Count only the glowing white lamps on the boat itself. Answer with a single digit: 0, 1, 2 or 3.
reference.q_bow: Look at the boat in this picture. Its bow is its pointed front end and its stern is its blunt back end. Is the pointed front end at the LEFT-hand side of the picture or at the RIGHT-hand side? Answer with exactly one word: left or right.
